scripts.preflight: tsc --noEmit && expo lint && vitest run && tsx scripts/validate-content.ts && tsx scripts/store-check.ts && npx expo-doctor
scripts.monkey: tsx scripts/monkey-engine.ts 3000 1 fr && tsx scripts/monkey-engine.ts 3000 2 en
scripts.ui:matrix: expo export --platform web --output-dir dist && node scripts/ui-matrix.mjs AB
scripts.explore: tsx scripts/explore-choices.ts 4000 fr && tsx scripts/explore-choices.ts 4000 en
scripts.qa: npm run preflight && npm run monkey && npm run stress && npm run explore
scripts.monkey:ui: expo export --platform web --output-dir dist && node scripts/monkey-ui.mjs 15 1000
scripts.promo:capture: expo export --platform web --output-dir dist && node promo/capture.mjs --lang fr && node promo/capture.mjs --lang en
scripts.promo:render: node promo/render.mjs --lang fr && node promo/render.mjs --lang en
scripts.promo:stills: node promo/stills.mjs --lang fr && node promo/stills.mjs --lang en
scripts.e2e:web: expo export --platform web --output-dir dist && node promo/e2e-flow.mjs
scripts.promo: npm run promo:capture && npm run promo:render && npm run promo:stills
scripts.intro:preview: node cinematic/render.mjs --lang fr --audio cinematic/out/intro-mix.wav --out docs/intro/valombre-intro-fr.mp4 && node cinematic/render.mjs --lang en --audio cinematic/out/intro-mix.wav --out docs/intro/valombre-intro-en.mp4
scripts.e2e:intro: expo export --platform web --output-dir dist && node promo/e2e-intro.mjs
scripts.dev:warnings: expo export --platform web --dev --output-dir dist-dev && node promo/dev-warnings.mjs dist-dev fr && node promo/dev-warnings.mjs dist-dev en
